title: Archived price points — FrontDeskReview
method: For each product, Internet Archive snapshots of the same source page our price of record comes from were read and the displayed US selling price extracted verbatim; ambiguous snapshots (JS-only rendering, unresolvable variants) were dropped rather than guessed. Each point links to its snapshot so any reader can verify the figure independently.
boundary: A separate record from our own tracking (/data/price-history.jsonl). Archive points are NOT observations we made and never feed 'lowest on record' or volatility computations.
